rounds.title: Practice round
rounds.note: These are made up. Swipe around to get the feel of it. Nothing here counts.

items.name: Mr. Buttons
items.sub: Teddy bear · Well loved · Red ribbon
items.bio: I guarded your pillow through every thunderstorm. My ribbon is faded but my hugs still work.
items.listing: Classic vintage teddy bear with a red ribbon, well loved with some fading. Soft, clean and ready for a new home.

items.name: Pink Roller Skates
items.bio: We owned the driveway every summer. My wheels still spin if you're still brave.
items.listing: Retro pink quad roller skates, women's size 6, with light scuffs. Wheels spin smooth and laces are in good shape.

items.name: Four Cloth Hardcovers
items.sub: Blue, green, yellow and red · Good shape
items.bio: We look great on a shelf and even better in a hammock. One of us still has your bookmark inside.
items.listing: Set of four cloth bound hardcover novels in blue, green, yellow and red. Great shelf decor, covers in good shape.

items.name: Instant Camera
items.sub: Mint and cream · Takes film packs
items.bio: I took the blurry birthday photo that's still on the fridge. Give me film and I'll make more.
items.listing: Mint and cream instant film camera in very good condition. Works great, film not included.

items.name: Ballerina Music Box
items.sub: Velvet lined · Still plays its song
items.bio: Wind me up and I'll dance for you like I did at bedtime. I keep earrings safe too.
items.listing: Pale blue ballerina music box, velvet lined, and the song still plays. Light wear on the outside.

items.name: Denim Jacket with Pins
items.sub: Light wash · Daisy, rainbow and heart pins
items.bio: I went to every concert and road trip with you. The pins tell the rest of the story.
items.listing: Light wash denim jacket with daisy, rainbow and heart pins. Gently worn, no rips or stains.
